title: 倫敦泰晤士潮汐隧道
summary: 從溢流口走到豎井、隧道與後端處理，學習為何截流、調蓄和抽送必須同時檢查；隧道本身不是污水淨化反應器。
summaryEn: Follow overflow interception through shafts, tunnel and downstream treatment, checking capture, storage and pumping together; the tunnel is not itself a purification reactor.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 合流區雨水入口：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Combined-catchment storm entry: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 合流區雨水入口：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Combined-catchment storm entry: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「合流區雨水入口」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at combined-catchment storm entry.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「合流區雨水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for combined-catchment storm entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「合流區雨水入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the combined-catchment storm entry measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.title: 溢流口尖峰歷線：尖峰流量與可用能力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Overflow peak hydrograph: Peak flow and available capacity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 溢流口尖峰歷線：尖峰流量與可用能力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Overflow peak hydrograph: Peak flow and available capacity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。本單元在「溢流口尖峰歷線」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks. Examine this relationship at overflow peak hydrograph.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：平均 Q=0.8 m³/s、假設尖峰係數 f=2.5。公式 Qp=fQ；代入 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s。適用邊界：係數為假設，不能代替地方降雨與下水道時序分析。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: mean Q=0.8 m³/s and assumed peak factor f=2.5. Formula Qp=fQ; substitution 0.8*2.5 = 2 m³/s. Boundary: The assumed factor does not replace local rainfall and sewer time-series analysis.
steps.failure: 把設計總能力當成檢修時可用能力，會漏算停機風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Using installed capacity during maintenance overlooks unavailable equipment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「溢流口尖峰歷線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for overflow peak hydrograph; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 溢流口尖峰歷線：尖峰流量與可用能力
knowledge.titleEn: Overflow peak hydrograph: Peak flow and available capacity
knowledge.text: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。本單元在「溢流口尖峰歷線」觀察此因果關係。
knowledge.textEn: Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks. Examine this relationship at overflow peak hydrograph.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「溢流口尖峰歷線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把尖峰係數改成3，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 m³/s。與基準 2 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the overflow peak hydrograph measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only the peak factor to3 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 m³/s. Compare with baseline 2 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
平均流量通過即可證明暴雨時不溢流。
平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Passing mean flow proves that storm overflows cannot occur.
Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks.
quiz.explanation: 平均流量用於年收支，尖峰流量決定瞬時水力負荷；泵站、攔污與沉澱單元可能有不同瓶頸。 把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「溢流口尖峰歷線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean flow supports annual balances, whereas peak flow governs instantaneous hydraulics; pumps, screens and clarifiers may have different bottlenecks. Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for overflow peak hydrograph; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
